programme.title: Saint Ange
programme.desc: Anna is a cleaning woman who accepts a post at the St. Ange Orphanage. She arrives to confront an unsettling lack of orphans, save for one who acts far too childish for her age. Then the bizarre sights and sounds begin, which seem to elude detection by the only other servant or the gloomy institution's director. Is this all in Anna's mind? Or does something more sinister lurk in the heart of St. Ange?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil is in the hot seat when disgruntled viewers ask him, “What were you thinking?” One guest is fuming about the advice he gave an overzealous soccer mom. Another guest claims she’ll never forgive Dr. Phil for letting an insensitive father get off too easy. Why is she so irked? Then, a viewer asks Robin if she ever disagrees with Dr. Phil’s advice? You’ll be surprised at her response! Plus, a proud Texan has a bone to pick with Dr. Phil; and a discouraged schoolteacher gives him a grammar lesson.

Another guest claims she’ll never forgive Dr. Phil for letting an insensitive father get off too easy. Why is she so irked? Then, a viewer asks Robin if she ever disagrees with Dr. Phil’s advice? You’ll be surprised at her response! Plus, a proud Texan has a bone to pick with Dr. Phil; and a discouraged schoolteacher gives him a grammar lesson.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 98 features the highly anticipated return of Jamal Ben Saddik (36-9, 29 KO) against the Estonian powerhouse Uku Jürjendal (20-9, 16 KO). In the co-main event of the evening, GLORY Welterweight World Champion Chico Kwasi (43-5-1, 23 KO) is set to defend his title against number two ranked welterweight Teodor Hristov (18-3, 7 KO). Meanwhile, two of 2024’s best prospects will clash as Cem Caceres (18-1, 14 KO) faces Mory Kromah (31-2-1, 18 KO).

programme.title: Saint Ange
programme.desc: Anna is a cleaning woman who accepts a post at the St. Ange Orphanage. She arrives to confront an unsettling lack of orphans, save for one who acts far too childish for her age. programme.desc: Dr. Phil is in the hot seat when disgruntled viewers ask him, “What were you thinking?” One guest is fuming about the advice he gave an overzealous soccer mom. You’ll be surprised at her response! Plus, a proud Texan has a bone to pick with Dr. Phil; and a discouraged schoolteacher gives him a grammar lesson.

Another guest claims she’ll never forgive Dr. Phil for letting an insensitive father get off too easy. Why is she so irked? Then, a viewer asks Robin if she ever disagrees with Dr. Phil’s advice? You’ll be surprised at her response! Plus, a proud Texan has a bone to pick with Dr. Phil; and a discouraged schoolteacher gives him a grammar lesson.

You’ll be surprised at her response! Plus, a proud Texan has a bone to pick with Dr. Phil; and a discouraged schoolteacher gives him a grammar lesson.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: In Dec 1995-Mar 1996, a surge of UFO sightings occurred, notably at Polvorin of As Gándaras, Lugo.
